name: component-catalog-screenshots
goal: Show visual component screenshots bound to the selected revision, retaining validated capture origins and explicit gaps.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual component catalogs need screenshots from the shown revision. Valid unchanged captures must name their original commit; invalid or missing captures remain gaps. Reuse the existing page card.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized catalog checks required text tables and never asserted component images. Extend their existing SSR and browser cases with fresh, inherited, missing, rejected and branch-switching evidence at all three viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed standardized tests at e8cc97a8 fail against the text-only catalog. Sealed record 50df1415 preserves the command, 1255 frozen inputs and all three viewport captures.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 implemented shared screenshot cards. Codex integrated validated selection, original capture labels, image-error resets and isolated caption styles; no source or nonvisual design images were added.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At 79a89bae, sealed record 33497369 passes the unchanged command and 1255 frozen inputs from failing-test commit e8cc97a8.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: 566 unit tests, 50 browser tests, web build, types, lint, audit and registry pass. Full verification awaits frozen-budget review and resumed Electron checks.
